cards.front: What is physics?
cards.back: The study of matter, energy, and their interactions

cards.front: What is the SI unit of length?
cards.back: Meter (m)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of mass?
cards.back: Kilogram (kg)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of time?
cards.back: Second (s)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of force?
cards.back: Newton (N)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of energy?
cards.back: Joule (J)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of power?
cards.back: Watt (W)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of pressure?
cards.back: Pascal (Pa)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of temperature?
cards.back: Kelvin (K)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of electric current?
cards.back: Ampere (A)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of voltage?
cards.back: Volt (V)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of resistance?
cards.back: Ohm (Ω)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of frequency?
cards.back: Hertz (Hz)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of wavelength?
cards.back: Meter (m)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of acceleration?
cards.back: Meter per second squared (m/s²)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of velocity?
cards.back: Meter per second (m/s)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of momentum?
cards.back: Kilogram meter per second (kg⋅m/s)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of work?
cards.back: Joule (J)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of charge?
cards.back: Coulomb (C)

cards.front: What is the SI unit of capacitance?
cards.back: Farad (F)

cards.front: What is Newton's First Law?
cards.back: An object at rest stays at rest, and an object in motion stays in motion unless acted upon by an external force

cards.front: What is Newton's Second Law?
cards.back: Force equals mass times acceleration (F = ma)

cards.front: What is Newton's Third Law?
cards.back: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction

cards.front: What is the principle of moments?
cards.back: For equilibrium, the sum of clockwise moments equals the sum of anticlockwise moments about any point

cards.front: What is the law of conservation of energy?
cards.back: Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed from one form to another

cards.front: What is the law of conservation of momentum?
cards.back: The total momentum of a closed system remains constant

cards.front: What is kinetic energy?
cards.back: Energy possessed by an object due to its motion (KE = ½mv²)

cards.front: What is potential energy?
cards.back: Energy possessed by an object due to its position or state

cards.front: What is gravitational potential energy?
cards.back: Energy possessed by an object due to its height above a reference point (PE = mgh)

cards.front: What is elastic potential energy?
cards.back: Energy stored in a stretched or compressed elastic object

cards.front: What is work done?
cards.back: The product of force and displacement in the direction of force (W = Fs)

cards.front: What is power?
cards.back: The rate at which work is done (P = W/t)

cards.front: What is efficiency?
cards.back: The ratio of useful work output to total work input

cards.front: What is friction?
cards.back: A force that opposes the relative motion of objects in contact

cards.front: What is static friction?
cards.back: Friction that prevents an object from starting to move

cards.front: What is kinetic friction?
cards.back: Friction that acts on an object that is already moving

cards.front: What is the coefficient of friction?
cards.back: A dimensionless scalar value that describes the ratio of the force of friction between two bodies

cards.front: What is centripetal force?
cards.back: The force that keeps an object moving in a circular path
